name: Scheduler
author: MouseGestures
description: Run gesture actions on a schedule instead of a gesture. Comes with ready-made schedules (mornings, end of day, sunrise, monthly…), and you can build your own or set a custom one right in the gesture: specific dates, days of the week, every N days or weeks, monthly (a day, the last day, the 2nd Tuesday), yearly, every N minutes, or sunrise and sunset. Then pick them as a Plugin trigger.
